question.text: Per SEBI's Investor Charter and complaints disclosure framework, within how many days of the end of each quarter must AIFs compile their investor complaints data and disclose it to investors and SEBI?

answer.text: Within 7 days from the end of quarter
Within 15 days from the end of quarter
Within 30 days from the end of quarter
Within 45 days from the end of quarter

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 13.5.1, AIFs are required to compile investor complaints data within 7 days from the end of each quarter and disclose it to investors and SEBI as part of the Investor Charter and complaints disclosure framework. The Trap: 15, 30 and 45 days are common timelines used for other AIF disclosure and redressal activities, but the quarterly compilation-and-disclosure window for investor complaints data is specifically 7 days. Note: The 7-day clock is tied to the end of each quarter and applies to compilation plus disclosure to both investors and SEBI.
